product_metadata.title: Goplus 3ft Prelit Christmas Tree, Battery Operated Spruce Fir Tree with 50 LED Lights and Timer Function, 363 Tips Solid Cement Base Tabletop Decorations Full Tree
features: 🎄Timer Function---Our Christmas tree is equipped with three timing functions. Set to first gear, light up for six hours; set to the second gear, the light stays on; set to the third gear, the light is off. Convenient for you to control according to your needs.
🎄50 LED Lights---The Christmas tree is decorated with 50 warm LED christmas string lights to brighten your space and add a strong festive glow to your home. Let you see its beauty even at night.

🎄Eco-friendly Material and Realistic Appearance---The blades of this Christmas tree are made from high quality PVC and PE material, which not only makes the tree looks more real and more full, but also add the anti-crush capacity to the tree. And 363 branch tips help emulate a real Christmas tree.
🎄Stable Cement Base---Cement base wrapped in linen helps support and balance the tree, preventing it from tipping over. At the same time, the simple linen has a good decorative effect.

🎄Easy to Move and Carry--This Christmas tree is battery operated to easily use anywhere without the hassle of power cords, easy for you to move and carry, as well as suitable for being placed in homes, offices, shops, hotels, etc.
